posts.text: About the F&O category — This happens a lot when the stop is inside Nifty’s normal daily noise. A quick check: the expected 1-day move from option prices is roughly Spot × IV × √(1/365). With Nifty around 25,000 and IV around 12%, that is about 25,000 × 0.12 × 0.052 ≈ 155 points. So a 40–60 point stop on an intraday or overnight trade can get hit by ordinary movement, even when your direction was right. Two things that help: Size the position from the stop, not the other way round. If the stop needs to be 150 points to sit outside normal noise, take fewer lots so the loss at that stop is still…
